entities.name: Purifying Fire
entities.description: Cool-burning white mana fire in Regatha that probes sin and can destroy mortals or drain planeswalkers of their spark.

entities.name: Regatha
entities.description: Place where the fire is located.

entities.name: Order of Heliud
entities.description: Order for which the fire is a source of power.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: Planeswalker sent into the fire who emerged unscathed.

events.summary: Walbert III sends Chandra Nalaar into the fire and she emerges unscathed.
events.quote: Chandra Nalaar was sent into the fire by Walbert III and emerged unscathed.

events.summary: Chandra destroys the fire's cavern and partially collapses the Temple of Heliud; the fire burns on under open sky.
events.quote: she destroyed the fire's cavern and partially collapsed the Temple of Heliud

relations.note: Source of power for the order.
relations.quote: a source of power for the Order of Heliud
